m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You there... can I interest you in a new robe? This is a cold land, and you should try to stay warm. What size are you?
Hmmm... trade with Wizard City? I can certainly do that! I will have to get some smaller sizes in stock, though...
<ITALICS>You explain that you're not robe shopping. You're here to set up trade with Wizard City. </ITALICS>
Welcome, young outsider! Where are you from, and what can I do for you?
Sounds good to me! I'll trade with anyone with gold in their pocket.
<ITALICS>You explain that you're from Wizard City, and that you're here to help set up trade with Grizzleheim. </ITALICS>
You look like you could use a new rune-carved ring. I have just the one in stock...
That sounds like a great idea! Sign me up! You should head back to tell Baldur that we are willing to trade.
<ITALICS>Before he tries to sell you something, you explain about the trade agreement. </ITALICS>
Good news! We have done well this day. Ready yourself... I will take you home now.
It was a pleasure working together. I wish you well in your future journeys.

You may be unable to return to Grizzleheim right away, but when you do return, your visit will be marked by kind words and open hearts. <ITALICS>You must be at least 20th level to return to Grizzleheim. </ITALICS>
When we get to Grizzleheim, speak to Thrain Stormfriend, Vidar Silverthread, and Dain Goldwright, and tell them of our new trade partners.
I would like to reward you for your help getting your merchants to agree to trade with my world.
Would you like to take a quick trip with me to visit Grizzleheim, my home? It will not take long, now that I know the way.
You can greet some tradesmen from Grizzleheim, and see if they will trade with Wizard City.
In Grizzleheim, speak to Thrain Stormfriend, Vidar Silverthread, and Dain Goldwright. Let them know I sent you with word of new trade partners.
